independent_unit: transitive connected component of endpoint image IDs in the 445-pair formal development sample
outer_design: assign complete endpoint components to five validation folds
inner_design: within each outer-training set, reassign its complete endpoint components to four validation folds
assignment_algorithm: deterministic largest-component-first greedy minimization followed by deterministic improving component moves
rare_level_policy: Do not split endpoint components or read outcomes to manufacture balance. Record structurally infeasible rare-level support as a warning and require downstream fold-train preprocessing to tolerate absent levels.
claim_boundary: A passing fold audit establishes graph-disjoint resampling structure only. It does not estimate model performance, choose a fitted model, or authorize calibration or confirmation outcome access.
